cases.name: Mary Nicole Sample
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Mary had the most infectious, beautiful smile that could light up your soul. If you were lucky enough to know her, you know she was a compassionate person who loved to be silly and have fun in whatever she was doing. She had a love for all animals. She loved to cook, but most of all she loved and adored her son Jaxon who was her world."
